elements.element: Licence extends to contractors acting on Customer's behalf

elements.evidence: Grant remains "a non-exclusive license to use the Interface" with no perpetuity language anywhere in the redline
No "irrevocable" wording inserted; grant clause unchanged apart from the licensee-scope expansion

elements.element: Subscription licences terminable only for uncured material breach
elements.evidence: No termination limitation added; nothing in the edited text restricts revocation to "uncured material breach"
"or to a successor in connection with a merger, consolidation, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets or equity"
"grants to Client and its affiliates" — affiliates covered outright, which subsumes coverage on notice

elements.element: Transferable to a successor in an M&A transaction
elements.evidence: "a successor in connection with a merger, consolidation, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets"

offending_extra_words: in connection with a merger, consolidation, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets or equity
reasons: Locked target was preferred, but the redline delivers only the licensee-scope expansion and successor transferability; it adds no perpetual/irrevocable language for paid-up licences and no restriction of termination/revocation to uncured material breach, so the preferred level is incomplete.
The fallback bargain is fully satisfied: affiliates are covered (indeed without any notice condition) and assignment to an M&A successor is permitted without consent.

Minimality fails. Operation 2 rewrites the assignment exception with a broad multi-limb successor formula ("merger, consolidation, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of the assigning party's assets or equity") where a short phrase such as "or to a successor in a merger or sale of substantially all assets" would suffice; the official gate flags both the 15→40 word expansion and a 0.610 changed-character ratio. Operation 1 also breaches the 1.50 expansion ratio (12→21 words).

"reorganization" and "or equity" widen the consent-free assignment right beyond the fallback's M&A scope and, because the exception is mutual, also let TrueLink assign away from us — extra words not needed to complete the selected level.

Intent is preserved: the unchanged non-exclusivity, field-of-use limitation and the Client's freedom to use alternative systems all remain effective, and no undefined term or dangling mechanic is introduced ("affiliates" and "contractors" are used in their ordinary sense, consistent with the existing "financially responsible affiliate" reference).
